extracted.name: Huckleberry Muffins
extracted.description: This huckleberry muffin recipe features fresh huckleberries, but can also can be substituted with blueberries, and takes only about a half hour to make.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease 15 muffin cups or line cups with paper liners.

Beat sugar and butter together in a bowl with an electric mixer until smooth; beat in milk, egg, and vanilla extract until well blended. Combine 1 ¾ cups flour, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl; stir into batter until just moistened. Toss huckleberries with 1 tablespoon flour in a bowl to coat: fold into batter.
Divide batter among the prepared muffin cups, filling each ⅔ full.
Bake in the preheated oven until tops spring back when lightly pressed, about 15 minutes.
